correctness.rationale: The equation is L(x)=y^(2r+1) with r=q/2 and exponents of L powers of two. At infinity over k(y) the negative valuation of a root is −(2r+1)/r; its denominator forces degree and ramification index r. The affine cover is étale since L′=1. The local parameter y²/x changes under each nonzero kernel translation by a term of order 2r+2, giving different exponent (r−1)(2r+2). Thus dy has divisor (2r(r−1)−2)P∞. The monomials x^i y^j dy with (2r+1)i+rj no greater than that number are indexed by j=2h or 2h+1 and 0≤i<r−1−h; distinct valuations and the genus count prove a basis. For odd intermediate y-degree, write the x-polynomial as E²+xO². A vanishing Cartier image implies E=T O and hence P=L O², impossible for nonzero P of degree <r. For even intermediate y-degree only odd x-degrees survive. The leading term of x^aT has degree a+r/2, so these polynomials cannot cancel the lower plain monomials with which they are grouped. In the even-y case, odd-indexed shifts retain those distinct high leading terms; even-indexed shifts retain only x^(a+1), already in the plain span. At both steps different nonzero branches have distinct output y-degrees, since the even/odd images land in the separate high/low ranges. The x-powers of degree <r are independent over k(y), so the ranks of these separated branches add. For N=r−1−h the paired contributions simplify to floor(N/4)+(N−1)/2 if h is even and 3N/2 otherwise. With r=4K the four-entry blocks give 18u−14, except the final block 1+3+0; summation gives 9K²−5K and subtracting from genus yields the displayed kernel dimension. The endpoint q=8 gives rank 4. Independently I used L+L²=x+x^(2r), so x=x^(2r)+y^(2r+1)+y^(4r+2). Expanding just the exponent of x modulo four gives the direct C² columns by retaining y-exponents 3 mod 4 and taking fourth roots of their square-free y components, then reducing x^r using L(x)=y^(2r+1). Exact sparse binary elimination gave ranks 4,26,124,536,2224 at q=8,16,32,64,128. This bounded calculation checks the count by a different extraction method; the all-q result follows from the parity and injectivity proof. Package replay path check_cartier.py was inspected, not run.
